title: Training Safe Distancing Ambassadors for Easing of COVID-19 Measures
what_it_is: Training Safe Distancing Ambassadors for Easing of COVID-19 Measures

sections.label: Safe distancing enforcement updates
sections.summary: Odd or even entry restrictions at four popular markets were lifted while enforcement at F&B hotspots was stepped up, with ambassadors and officers regularly updated on measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: For example, we recently lifted the odd or even entry restrictions at the four popular markets but stepped up our enforcement at F&B hotspots.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In line with this, our Safe Distancing Ambassadors and Enforcement Officers are regularly updated on the safe distancing measures, including the rules of engagement with premises operators and members of the public.

sections.label: Mandatory mask wearing
sections.summary: Mask wearing remains mandatory outside homes, as an A*STAR study found cough particles can travel over one metre in eight seconds without a mask.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Mask wearing will remain mandatory for anyone leaving their homes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: A recent study by A*STAR found that small particles from a person’s cough could travel more than one metre within eight seconds if no mask was worn.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: On the other hand, wearing a mask would help reduce the spread of the virus, by significantly reducing the droplets and aerosols ejected from a person’s nose and mouth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Everyone should put on your mask at all times, including putting your mask back on immediately after activities such as eating, drinking or engaging in strenuous exercise.

sections.label: Mask after eating rule
sections.summary: The rules state that a mask should be put on immediately after finishing eating.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The rules are quite clear – which is, immediately after you have finished eating, you should put on a mask.

sections.label: Ambassadors remind then enforce
sections.summary: Safe Distancing Ambassadors remind, and after repeated reminders enforcement may be carried out if reminders do not work.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: However, the Safe Distancing Ambassadors are there to remind; sometimes to enforce.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We hope that reminders will work; if not, then in some cases, after repeated reminders, we may have to enforce.
